host_telemetry.hostname_policy: Repository-facing hostnames use the logical roles car and d1.
host_telemetry.process_policy: Host and process resource counters are retained; process command lines are omitted.

text_artifacts.policy: Deployment-specific endpoint addresses, hostnames, absolute paths, private IP addresses, and MAC addresses are replaced with logical placeholders.

edge_verification.policy: Remote-to-raw-local checksum comparison completed before sanitization; sanitized text files are not expected to retain raw hashes.

location.policy: The public tree retains the stationary summary and 0.001-degree coordinate only. Exact GPS CSV and rosbag remain in the separately committed raw tree at the user's direction.

raw_recovery: The original files, including exact GNSS and deployment metadata, remain in the checksum-manifested raw run tree.
